system.description: This power allows the Kiasyd to play minor magical pranks. By defeating a target in a Mental Challenge, you can create spontaneous effects — nothing overtly harmful, but certainly annoying to the victim (a deafening scream, a slip and fall, a jammed gun, dropped pants, a minute of sneezing, etc.). The effect of this power should be regulated closely by a Narrator. (This power is listed as an additional level-2 Mytherceria power in this supplement.)
